Comment: Check every item of a new household copy. A Map with MaxConcurrency 3 starts the MatchStateMachine three at a time instead of fifteen at once, so a visitor clicking 'Make my own copy' cannot start a Textract stampede. The executions are started, not awaited (startExecution, not .sync): an alert pauses at WaitForApproval for up to 24 h, and this run must not wait for a human.

Stagger.Comment: Hold the slot for two seconds so the three in flight stay three: the checks themselves run in their own executions.

Skipped.Comment: One item failed to start (throttling past the retries). The rest of the copy still gets checked; the card shows its own error state.
